task: binary ribosome-stalling probability inference on the complete released test arrays
network_selection_reason: This is the template used by official script/demo_test.py; its parallel convolution branches accept the released 61-codon inputs and matched both released checkpoints in a two-row compatibility probe.
compatibility_changes_only: Replace hard-coded HDF5 list paths with run-local paths.
Set the TEST batch size to the complete released test-array size.
Run the same Caffe network in CPU mode because the installed package is CPU-only.

encoding.codon_order: nested A,T,C,G outer-to-inner loops, exactly as official demo_test.py

selection_rule: No model selection, no tuning and no test-driven checkpoint choice; use the sole released best_model_0.caffemodel for each study.
explicit_nonclaims: Not a 64-checkpoint ensemble: the release contains only best_model_0.caffemodel per study.
Not model training or reproduction of the 100000-iteration 64-model protocol.
Not continuous codon dwell-time or velocity regression; outputs are binary stalling probabilities.
Not protein OOD, study OOD, functional OOD, matched-cost comparison, SOTA or a CodonFlow-RK result.
Not independent raw-read remapping or P-site remapping; the released arrays are author-processed test data.
